newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BOURSE OFFICIAL LIST TO START APRIL 7.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE OFFICIAL LIST TO START APRIL 7.

text.p: The Lithuanian stock exchange is to start trading its new official list of shares on April 7, stock exchange director general Rimantas Busila said on Monday.
"Next Tuesday we (the stock exchange board) are planning to discuss the candidate list to the official trading list and we plan that the trade will start on April 7," Busila told Reuters.
He said that four applications to be included on the list have already been received from Vilnius and Hermis banks and the Rokishkis Cheese and Medienos Plaushas companies.

"It is a new list where only the most reliable companies in the country will be included, companies which have a good name on the market, companies whose financial reports are stably growing and the market share fluctuates only slightly," he added.
Lithuania currently has the LITIN A list as it main list and the LITIN B list as a secondary list.
The stock exchange wants to boost trade on the market, which is seen as less liquid than its Baltic neighbours Latvia and Estonia.
